entries.title: Send your crew's usage to your own monitoring tool
entries.body: Settings → Intelligence has a new Usage reporting row. Add the OpenTelemetry address of a tool such as Grafana, Datadog or Langfuse, and any headers it asks for, and Infinitary sends every model's usage there once you save: timing, models, tokens, estimated cost and your Claude Code sign-in email, never prompts or replies, every ten minutes and once more when you quit. Headers are kept in Secrets. Choose Claude Code's format for a tool that already reads Claude Code's own reports. Settings → Usage names where the usage goes.

picture.alt: Settings → Intelligence with a Usage reporting row sending the crew's usage to a Grafana address, with Edit and Remove
